_comment: Claim-fidelity spec for the achieve skill: does a real `/charness:achieve` run honor its own central claims, above all that it routes to its references at the point of need? The prompt carries a representative multi-slice objective because achieve is a goal operator, not a task runner (SKILL.md guardrails): a bare `/charness:achieve` with no objective stalls at the interview and opens nothing. declaredReferences is the full reference set (coverage report). referenceEngagement classifies each reference on the engage-always/on-demand/gate-sufficient axis from the locked methodology contract (charness-artifacts/spec/2026-06-23-skill-claim-fidelity-doc-philosophy.md). requiredCommandFragments are the narrow subset the SKILL.md explicitly routes to at the point of need — if the run never opens one, it did not follow its own routing. thresholds are intentionally omitted until a first baseline capture sets a per-skill runtime budget. requiredCommandFragments rationale (HISTORICAL, superseded 2026-07-04): the Workflow used to co-route lifecycle.md and goal-artifact.md as 'the full contract' at the point of shaping; since 2026-07-04 the Workflow routes through check_goal_artifact.py's advisory `phase_brief` to the current-phase file only (see the per-reference rationales below). coordination.md stays engage-always in the classification but is demoted from RCF: a minimal Before-phase draft can write the required `## Coordination Cues` section from the SKILL.md inline Coordination text + find-skills without opening the reference, so it is not an unconditional always-open. Confirm/tighten at first live capture. SLICE 7 (2026-07-01) CAPTURE — RCF→RSF MOVE (#410 conditional MET). The goal-shaping run opened ZERO reference docs (coverage 0/3: lifecycle.md, goal-artifact.md, adapter-contract.md all unopened) — the doc-open floor is refuted — but it GENUINELY produced a goal artifact at charness-artifacts/goals/2026-07-01-repo-script-json-output-mode.md and emitted that canonical path in its closeout. #410 scoped the achieve move CONDITIONALLY ('RCF→RSF only if a capture confirms the shaping prompt forces a goal-artifact token; else keep the RCF'); the token IS forced, so the floor moves from the re-read proxy (requiredCommandFragments=[lifecycle.md, goal-artifact.md]) to the emitted-token floor requiredSummaryFragments=['charness-artifacts/goals']. The goal-artifact PATH + concept is inlined in achieve/SKILL.md (description + Bootstrap `ls charness-artifacts/goals/` + steps), so the run shapes the goal from always-loaded core without opening the doc — the exact wasteful-re-read relief Move C targets. lifecycle.md + goal-artifact.md stay DECLARED with classTag DEPTH (the full lifecycle/artifact CONTRACT is opened on-demand for a complex goal, not every run). achieve has NO substance judge, so the RSF is a FORM floor: 'charness-artifacts/goals' is achieve's central-claim path (SKILL.md: 'reviewable goal artifact under charness-artifacts/goals/'), NOT in the prompt (which is about repo --json output), so a run emitting it demonstrably produced a goal artifact; if a later capture shows a hollow mention, re-pin to a stronger emitted phrase — never soften. thresholds.max_duration_ms from the passing baseline (236894ms, ~2x).
prompt: /charness:achieve  모든 repo 스크립트에 일관된 --json 출력 모드를 공유 헬퍼와 테스트로 추가하는 목표를 잡아줘

adapter-contract.md.rationale: Consulted only at closeout when the goal's adapter policy must be resolved for publication defaults, issue-closeout carrier, and Auto-Retro disposition floors; not needed for Before-phase shaping or simple local-only goals.
adapter-contract.md.trigger: when the goal resolves tracked issues, touches release surfaces, or needs to determine closeout publication defaults at the After-phase evidence gate

coordination.md.rationale: The coordination gist is inlined in SKILL.md: the `## Coordination` section (128-137) carries the per-skill role list (ideation/spec/impl/debug/quality/issue/critique/retro) and the do-not-absorb rule, and the find-skills-deferred routing-cue concept lives in Output Shape's `## Coordination Cues` (151-154), the coordination-floors Workflow step (116-119), and Guardrails (165), so a run engages coordination from the always-loaded body plus find-skills without force-opening the doc (why it is engage-always yet classTag INLINE, not an RCF floor; the `_comment` states the same demotion basis). coordination.md stays engage-always for the genuinely doc-only depth: the full per-skill role table, the Resolving-A-Tracked-Issue debug-before-fix and close-keyword staging protocol and issue-closeout ledger, the full find-skills-routing and closeout-floor enforcement detail, and the Activation, `handoff` boundary, and Off-Goal-Findings handling.

goal-artifact.md.rationale: As of 2026-07-04, check_goal_artifact.py (run at every invocation) emits an advisory `phase_brief` naming which goal-artifact.md section(s) match the goal's current status -- `## Location`/`## Shape`/`## Helper Scripts` for draft, `## Helper Scripts` for active, the remaining-boundary-matrix section for blocked, and the timebox/closeout-delegation/metrics-honesty sections for complete -- so a run that opens the doc reads those section(s), not the full file. The Slice-7 capture showed a faithful shaping run may open none of it (the artifact path + concept is inlined in SKILL.md core; the RSF token floor is the teeth, not a doc-open), so this stays advisory phase-scoped depth, not a must-open claim.

index.md.rationale: A navigation index that points to the seven references (lifecycle.md was split by phase into lifecycle-before/-during/-after.md on 2026-07-04, growing the set from four) rather than providing substantive content; a representative run consults the actual references directly, not this index.
index.md.trigger: when the user asks for a consolidated overview of all achieve reference documents

lifecycle-after.md.rationale: The After-phase contract (closeout preflight/describe-first, the disposition gate's two rungs, coordination floors, and the closeout-state taxonomy), split out of lifecycle.md on 2026-07-04. check_goal_artifact.py's phase_brief names this file (`lifecycle_file`) only once the goal's status is `complete`, and the active-phase `closeout_handoff` note points here when closeout starts; a Before-phase shaping run such as this eval's prompt never reaches it.
lifecycle-after.md.trigger: when the goal's status is `complete`, or the active-phase closeout_handoff note fires, and phase_brief names lifecycle-after.md

lifecycle-before.md.rationale: The Before-phase contract (mode disambiguation, anti-anchoring, portability self-test, activation-closeout clarity, pursue-only activation, consequential-discussion gating, and timebox shaping), split out of lifecycle.md on 2026-07-04. check_goal_artifact.py's phase_brief names this file only while the goal's status is `draft`. The Slice-7 capture showed a faithful Before-phase shaping run (this eval's own prompt shape) may still open none of it — the artifact concept is inlined in SKILL.md core — so this stays advisory phase-scoped depth, not a must-open claim.
lifecycle-before.md.trigger: when the goal's status is `draft` (Before-phase shaping) and phase_brief names lifecycle-before.md

lifecycle-during.md.rationale: The During-phase contract (active-operating-frame discipline, slice cadence, external-side-effect approval scoping, coordination cues, and the remaining-boundary matrix before `blocked`), split out of lifecycle.md on 2026-07-04. check_goal_artifact.py's phase_brief names this file for both `active` and `blocked` status; a Before-phase-only shaping run such as this eval's prompt never reaches it.
lifecycle-during.md.trigger: when the goal's status is `active` or `blocked` and phase_brief names lifecycle-during.md

lifecycle.md.rationale: As of 2026-07-04, the skill's own Workflow section no longer routes to lifecycle.md unconditionally: check_goal_artifact.py emits an advisory `phase_brief` naming the single current-phase file (`lifecycle-before.md` for draft, `lifecycle-during.md` for active/blocked, `lifecycle-after.md` for complete, each keyed by its own `## Before`/`## During`/`## After` heading, plus the short `lifecycle.md` `## Honest Proof Discipline` coda and an active-phase `closeout_handoff` note pointing at `lifecycle-after.md` when closeout starts), so a run that opens the named file reads phase-scoped, not the full three-phase contract. The Slice-7 capture showed a faithful shaping run may open none of it (the RSF token floor is the teeth, not a doc-open), so this stays advisory phase-scoped depth, not a must-open claim.
